sources.title: ATO: Cents per kilometre method
sources.fact: Read by an agent on 24 September 2026 (page last updated 12 August 2026); not yet reviewed by a person. 91 cents per kilometre for 2026-27; 88 cents for 2024-25 and 2025-26; 85 cents for 2023-24. Maximum 5,000 work-related kilometres a year per car. The rate covers all car expenses including decline in value, registration, insurance, maintenance, repairs and fuel.

sources.title: ATO: Logbook method
sources.fact: Read by an agent on 24 September 2026 (page last updated 12 June 2026); not yet reviewed by a person. Logbook covers at least 12 continuous weeks, is broadly representative, records purpose, destination and odometer readings for each work journey, and is valid for 5 years unless circumstances change. Fuel may be receipted or reasonably estimated from odometer readings, consumption and average price. Decline in value is limited by the car limit ($69,674 for 2025-26 in the page example); effective life generally 8 years. EV and PHEV electricity by actual cost or the home charging rate in PCG 2024/2.
